title: Minimum-Tracking Stack
commonMistakes: Scanning the entire stack on every getMin call
Forgetting that popping the current minimum must reveal the previous minimum
Treating duplicate minimum values as a single occurrence
Emitting a value for push operations or forgetting the -1 result for pop
followUps: How would you support getMax at the same time?
Can you implement the stack with one array of values and one array of minima?
What changes if operations may pop from an empty stack?
attribution: Original problem by the Base Case contributors.
